title: festuca regeliana
intro: Festuca regeliana, commonly known as Tibetan or Mongolian dwarf grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, where its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Festuca regeliana are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
